note: November 2026 — handwritten: US news, the Christmas sets and colourways, order-by dates, gift guides and the updated Bespoke Planner. Only sent if this month matches; December writes itself.
subject: 🐸 Christmas at the pond, and the frogs can cross the Atlantic
heading: From the pond this month
body_html:
Hello. A bit more news than usual this month, so grab a cuppa.

Frog Logic now posts properly to the US. About one in five people who visit the shop are in America, and until now the only thing they could really buy was a download — sending a tee across the Atlantic cost more than the tee. So I found US printers. Tees, mugs, prints and notebooks are now made and posted inside the US: no Atlantic postage, and no import charge on the doorstep. Choose the United States in the basket and the postage shows before you pay.

If you've got a friend over there who'd like something from the pond, this is the moment to send them the link.

Christmas has arrived at the pond. The frog has put on a Santa hat, got under a blanket, tangled itself in the fairy lights, and is not coming out until January. It's called Socially Hibernating, and it comes as a set for one price with delivery included: a hoodie, a tee and a fleece throw in the UK (£110 with the sofa-size throw, £93 with the lap-size one), or a hoodie, a tee and an embroidered beanie in the US (£92). You pick the colour and size of each piece. UK set · US set. Everything is printed to order, so earlier is safer for Christmas.

There are personalised pieces too, with any name you like on them: a frog mug, a tree ornament and a candle, on the Etsy shop.

The Christmas frog also comes in bright colours and in black and white, because people in the groups asked for both. They're kept separate, so you can go straight to the one that suits: originals · bright · black and white. There are printable Christmas cards to match, £3 for three designs, sent by email straight away, so they still work on Christmas Eve.

Order by: printed pieces by Thursday 10 December for UK delivery, and Monday 7 December for the US.

Stuck for ideas? I've put together a few gift guides: ADHD gifts · gifts for autistic adults · gifts for SEN parents and carers · stocking fillers under £15. Or all the Christmas gifts on one page.

The Bespoke Planner has grown up. It now asks fifteen questions instead of nine, and builds up to eighteen pages from your answers. Four of them use your own words: a Hard Day page with a tear-off half to hand to someone, a page written to your partner, manager, teacher or parent, your start and end of day as tick-lists, and a don't-forget strip on every daily page. Because it does so much more, the price is now £25. If it doesn't fit, answer again and it gets rebuilt, free. Have a look at the planner.

Still yours, because you signed up: POND10 takes 10% off your first order. It works on US orders too.

One small apology: if September's note landed in your inbox twice, that was a glitch on my side, and it's fixed.

That's the lot. Go gently.
